description: Source code implementing platform service functions for Android in the Cobalt project, including opening, closing, sending messages, and JNI interactions.

classes.name: CobaltExtensionPlatformServicePrivate
classes.description: Private data structure for managing Cobalt platform service state, including context, callback, name, and JNI object reference.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if the Cobalt service exists by name via JNI call.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a Cobalt platform service, creating a private structure and JNI references.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the Cobalt platform service, releasing JNI references and deleting the private structure.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data to the Cobalt service, receiving a response and handling JNI data conversion.
